messages:
emma_csm: Flagging a short 'commit overshoot' event in today's health run. three hosted customers spiked for ~12-20m this morning around 09:00 UTC. anomaly score high.

leah_data: Ran a quick detection query. top hit = cust-orion (peak ~3.5x baseline tpm). window 08:56-09:10 UTC. no sustained tail.

jules_fin: Preliminary exposure if sustained = $10.8k vs commit $3.5k. marking "investigate" in ledger.

rick_ops: Any backend errors or rate-limit signs? I see a tiny 429 bump on gateway during the window (08:59-09:03).

healthbot: alert: short_spend_blip detected for [cust-orion, cust-sable, cust-lotus]. score=0.91. runbook: /runbooks/spend-short-blip

emma_csm: CSM owners: please reach out proactively once we confirm whether this was client-side. better to be transparent.

leah_data: Exporting session_ids and request_ids now. early look suggests many new streaming sessions rather than retries.

jules_fin: Finance prefers to hold off on automated credits. recommend offering one-off goodwill credit if customer reports negative impact. max cap suggested $1.5k.

rick_ops: We deployed a minor routing tweak to us-west canary at 08:50 but it was read-only. no autoscaler alerts. could be coincidence.

emma_csm: Action list: 1) leah to DM session/request export (ETA 1.5h). 2) rick to review deploy + routing diffs (ETA 45m). 3) jules to prepare optional credit wording (ETA EOD). 4) emma to prep outreach template.

leah_data: DMing the CSV in 20. will flag which sessions had retries. :mag:

billingbot: provisional charge estimate for cust-orion if spike persists = $10,800. awaiting finalization.

emma_csm: Thanks all. keep replies short here so we have a clean audit for the weekly pack. I'll add a detector rule suggestion: surface 5-20m high-variance windows separately from long-term drift.

jules_fin: noted. will add to finance checklist for next reconciliation.

emma_csm: Closing for now, will update when we have customer confirmation or if ops finds infra cause. :handshake:
